summary: Verified by reading the file and exercising it live. Adds REPLAY config, visibleRatio() using min(rect.height, viewportHeight) denominator, replayTargets(), enterReplaySection(), exitReplaySection() with animationend + setTimeout fallback, generation guard. Non-replay elements keep single-threshold observer and once:true. Public API unchanged; triggerStagger() now clears exit/reset state. Replay targets are never unobserved.
